result.detail: Klaviyo OAuth apps can be shared by install URL with any customer without listing or review. Marketplace listing is optional. The only number in the docs is 5 active installs, and that is a requirement for marketplace submission, not a cap on unlisted apps. Customers can also make their own private API keys (Owner, Admin or Manager role). Caveat: user-scoped apps may need a customer admin to allowlist them. That is the customer's own admin, not a Klaviyo review. This comes from a subagent's reading of the page and the search snippets. I did not fetch the page myself.
result.quote: Your app does not have to be listed to share and use your installation URL with customers.
